crossRefs.note: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:
Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.
I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the…
If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good of the land;
but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

translations.web: “You shall say to this people, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
translations.bsb: Furthermore, you are to tell this people that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
translations.kjv: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
translations.asv: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
